purpose: The action row: every row of buttons in an app (dialog buttons, form Save/Cancel, a record's Edit and Delete, a Delete confirm).
namedChanges: The header comment is reworded; no code change.
Added after the copy (0.1.1): the optional primary, cancel and destructive slots, the narrow-width rule and the dev warning; the children API is unchanged.

0.1.2: the structured row carries the class `gs-actionrow` and marks the destructive slot `gs-actionrow__far`, writes the shared action-row CSS once (`src/actionRowCss.ts`, a copy of style-runtime's, kept identical by a test) so the equal-share narrow rule works without Tailwind, and takes `confirm` (no far slot, Cancel then a red primary, Cancel the default). The children API output is unchanged.

library.title: Button row: Save/Cancel, Edit/Delete, confirm delete (Mac order, action row)
library.note: Use for every row of buttons: dialog, form, a record's Edit + Delete, 'Delete X?' confirm. Positive rightmost, Cancel left of it, Delete alone at far left. Comes with the app style (style-runtime). For one button look take button; for the remove control take remove-control.
